note: One portfolio, the same for everyone, built from the research. Paper only. Not advice.

holdings.name: Whole US stock market
holdings.line: The foundation: own a little of the whole market.
holdings.why: Most of the portfolio is simply the whole US market: cheap and widely diversified. Everything else is a smaller tilt on top.
holdings.risk: It moves with the whole market, up and down. In a bad year it can fall 30% or more.
theses: The foundation of the portfolio, not a separate research call.

holdings.name: AI chips and equipment
holdings.line: The chips and tools powering the AI buildout.
holdings.why: Companies are spending hundreds of billions a year on AI data centers; the suppliers get paid either way. Includes the memory makers (Memory super-cycle, Medium-High), so memory isn't counted twice.
holdings.risk: AI spending is being punished on earnings right now (the 'capex crack'). Chips can fall 30-40% inside a bull run.
theses: House view: AI Infrastructure (High) + Phase 1 to Phase 2 rotation (High)

holdings.name: Alphabet
holdings.line: Search, cloud and a big stake in AI.
holdings.why: A cash-rich leader in search, cloud and AI, held at half weight because it is one company.
holdings.risk: A large share of its cloud backlog comes from a few big customers, and one company can always disappoint.

holdings.name: Gold
holdings.line: A possible cushion when markets get uneasy.
holdings.why: Gold has often held up when stocks fell, so it can soften losses elsewhere in the portfolio. Often, not always.
holdings.risk: Gold earns no income, can go sideways for years, and can fall at the same time as stocks.
theses: House view: Hard Assets / Scarcity sleeve (High, Hedge)

holdings.name: Defense and space
holdings.why: Record order backlogs and rising defense budgets.
holdings.risk: Depends on government budgets; backlogs have started to dip at some of the biggest names.

holdings.name: Nuclear and power
holdings.line: AI data centers need power around the clock.
holdings.why: AI data centers need power around the clock; nuclear is the steady source the big tech companies are signing up for.
holdings.risk: Nuclear projects run late and over budget; much of the hope is already in the price.
theses: House view: Nuclear / AI Power Stack (Medium)

holdings.name: Healthcare
holdings.line: A balance to the tech-heavy holdings.
holdings.why: Weight-loss drugs, an ageing population and beaten-down prices in parts of the sector.
holdings.risk: Drug-price politics can hit the whole sector at once.

holdings.name: Robots and automation
holdings.line: Machines that bring AI into the physical world.
holdings.why: AI is moving from screens into machines: factories, warehouses, cars.
holdings.risk: Early: no pure-play humanoid robot company is listed yet, and the theme is already popular.

holdings.name: Bitcoin fund
holdings.line: A small, measured piece of a volatile asset.
holdings.why: A small, fixed slice of the most established crypto asset, through a regulated fund.
holdings.risk: It can halve in months. Kept small on purpose.
theses: House view: Crypto (Medium) + the Running Thesis crypto rungs

holdings.name: Short-term Treasury bills
holdings.line: Earn interest while waiting for a possible dip.
holdings.why: The Running Thesis gives better-than-even odds of a dip before December (58% chance of a SPY close at or below 740 first), a December Fed hike is priced in, and credit spreads are widening. Part of the model waits in T-bills, earning interest.
holdings.risk: Set by the Running Thesis: 15% while it gives 55% or better odds of a dip before its next horizon, 0% otherwise. When the dip arrives or the view changes, the T-bills move into the core and the change is logged.

not_held.name: software
not_held.why: Not held: AI agents let companies build what they used to buy.

not_held.name: oil
not_held.why: Not held: the research avoids betting directly on oil.

not_held.name: Quantum computing
not_held.why: On the watch list, not held yet.

not_held.name: Critical minerals
not_held.why: On the watch list, not held yet.
